title: Shared Radio
summary: Songbird picks a station by memory from V's car by the Dogtown Wall market, and is often wrong.

start.bringUp: Songbird wants to tune a radio by memory, with V in the car, and she has already decided she will be wrong about the station.

spot.name: the parking lot by the Dogtown Wall market

spot-b.name: the far end of the same parking lot

SBH1.ask.01.text: Is it the right song, or only the right mood?

g1.asks: Is it the right song, or only the right mood?
g1.know: The current song and the station you tuned to.
g1.secret: She was trying to remember a person.

variations.know: Only talk stations are on the air today.
The station you can tune to plays only one genre tonight.

variations.wants: V picks the station and she guesses the decade of the song.

stages.label: Songbird picks a station by memory
stages.know: V is parked by the market with the radio on. You picked the station by memory and you expect to be wrong.
stages.wants: V's ear for the station, and V's honest take on the song.

honest.memory: You sat in the car by the Dogtown Wall market and told Songbird the truth about the song she picked by memory.

faked.memory: You pretended the station was the one Songbird remembered. She could tell, and she let you have it anyway.

left.memory: You let Songbird's radio play by the Dogtown Wall market and did not say much about it.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the parking lot by the Dogtown Wall market, and Songbird's radio played on alone.
